-- Job status, joined with the stored research once the job has finished.
-- Jobs stuck in 'running' for over 10 minutes are reported as failed.
SELECT
  j.id::text AS job_id,
  CASE
    WHEN j.status = 'running' AND j.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' THEN 'failed'
    ELSE j.status
  END AS status,
  CASE
    WHEN j.status = 'running' AND j.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' THEN 'Research took too long and was stopped.'
    ELSE j.error
  END AS error,
  j.input,
  j.domain,
  j.created_at,
  j.updated_at,
  CASE WHEN j.status IN ('completed', 'cached') THEN to_jsonb(cr) END AS record
FROM research_jobs j
LEFT JOIN company_research cr ON cr.domain = j.domain
WHERE j.id::text = $1;

UPDATE research_jobs
SET status = 'failed',
    error = $2,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE execution_id = $1
  AND status = 'running';

-- Saved research, newest first (Overview, Saved Companies).
-- One row out: { records: [...] } so the webhook returns a single JSON object.
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(c ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS records
FROM (
  SELECT id, domain, status, updated_at, company_facts, research_signals,
         synthesized_research, sources, icp_score, icp_tier, icp_breakdown, account_brief
  FROM company_research
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 200
) c;

-- Recent research requests and outcomes (Overview activity log).
-- Jobs stuck in 'running' for over 10 minutes are reported as failed, as in /research/status.
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(j ORDER BY j.created_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS jobs
FROM (
  SELECT
    id::text AS job_id,
    CASE WHEN status = 'running' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' THEN 'failed' ELSE status END AS status,
    input,
    domain,
    CASE WHEN status = 'running' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
         THEN 'Research took too long and was stopped.' ELSE error END AS error,
    created_at
  FROM research_jobs
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 50
) j;

-- Saved research for one domain (one row even when missing).
SELECT cr.domain, cr.icp_score, cr.icp_tier, cr.icp_breakdown, cr.synthesized_research
FROM (SELECT 1) AS input
LEFT JOIN company_research cr
  ON cr.domain = $1
 AND cr.status = 'validated';

-- Save the recalculated score and append it to the history.
-- updated_at is left alone: it is the research date, not the scoring date.
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE company_research
  SET icp_score = $2, icp_tier = $3, icp_breakdown = $4::jsonb
  WHERE domain = $1 AND status = 'validated'
  RETURNING *
), history AS (
  INSERT INTO icp_score_history
    (domain, trigger, score, tier, algorithm_version, config_version, snapshot_id,
     evidence_fingerprint, result, evidence, calculated_at)
  SELECT domain, 'recalculate', $2, $3, $5, $6, $7, $8, $4::jsonb, $9::jsonb, $10::timestamptz
  FROM updated
)
SELECT to_jsonb(updated) AS record FROM updated;
